|strategy=By [mailto:vanfleet@bucknell.edu Jim Van Fleet]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/ominousrumors.html</ref>

The [[Hoth (Dark){{!}}Hoth]] expansion introduced [[Echo Base Operations]], and Cloud City included [[Dark Deal]]. Now [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] gives us [[Ominous Rumors]], another Effect that can have an entire deck strategy built around it. As with the other Force drain bonus cards, this one requires a balanced deck; control of both battleground systems and [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] sites. The payoff is increased Force drains in space, a feature where the Dark side has struggled in the past. Meeting the basic requirements of [[Ominous Rumors]] will give the Dark side a Force drain of 4 at the [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] system! As with EBO, the Imperials must retain control of [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] sites to keep [[Ominous Rumors]] in play. This Effect may have limited value in [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] booster draft play, since it must be deployed before the Light side controls any [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] sites, and there are only 3 systems available in the expansion. If a player was fortunate enought to get [[Ominous Rumors]] up and running, however, they would drain their opponent out very quickly. It is also one of the two staple cards required to flip your [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost{{!}}Endor Operations]] objective.

Combos: - will give a Light side [[Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers{{!}}Hidden Base]] deck some serious trouble. Spread out, probe and drain with TIEs without fear of battle damage.

- At the [[Endor: Bunker (Dark){{!}}Endor: Bunker]] or any [[Endor (Dark){{!}}Endor]] battleground site, Dyer prevents the cancellation of your Effect. [[Ominous Rumors]] + [[Endor: Bunker (Dark){{!}}Endor: Bunker]] + [[Perimeter Patrol]] discouraging them form coming to ground while you dominate the skies.
